title: TemplateUpdate
description:
The complete replacement state for a template, sent to `PUT /templates/{template_id}`. This is
a full replacement, not a partial update: send every field you want the template to have.
Omitting the optional `description`, `barcodes`, `default_actions`, `default_triggers`, or
`presentation` clears them.

`type` is immutable after creation and is not part of the update body: the template keeps the
pass type it was created with. Send the current `template_version` as the concurrency token; if
it doesn't match the stored version, the update is rejected with `409` (`stale_template_version`).

template_version.description: The version of the template being replaced, taken from your last read or write response. On success the stored version is incremented; on mismatch the update returns `409`.

description.description: Optional free-form description of the template. Omitting it clears the description.

issuer.description: Issuer information displayed on passes created from this template.

branding.description: Visual branding applied to passes created from this template.

refresh_policy.description: When passes created from this template refresh their content.

barcodes.description:
Barcodes inherited by passes that use this template. Omitting this field clears the template
barcodes. The pass-level `barcodes` field on `RevPassBaseContent` defines the inherit,
replace, and suppress rules.

default_actions.description: Buttons rendered on passes created from this template. Omitting it clears the default actions.

default_triggers.description: Context-aware notifications attached to passes created from this template. Omitting it clears the default triggers.

localisation.description: Translations resolved by `localisation_key` at render time.

presentation.description:
Optional explicit layout applied to generic passes created from this template. A
presentation defined on the pass itself takes precedence over the template layout.
Provide it only when the template `type` is `generic_pass`. Providing it when the template
`type` is not `generic_pass` returns `422` (`presentation_not_allowed`). Omitting it clears
the template layout.

Action.description: A button rendered on the pass (e.g. "Open website", "Get directions").

id.description: Unique identifier for the action within this pass.

type.description: Documented values: `open_external_url`. External URL domain needs to be registered at onboarding.

label.description: Display label for the button, with optional localisation.

importance.description: Relative prominence of this action (5 = primary, 1 = least prominent).

Barcode.description: A machine-readable barcode displayed on a Revolut native pass.

format.description: Symbology used to render the barcode.

type.description: Payload type. Only static barcode payloads are supported.

static_payload.description: Static value encoded in the barcode.

Branding.description: Optional visual branding for a pass.

brand_name.description: Brand name displayed on the pass.

logo.description: Logo image used by the pass.

background_image.description: Background or hero image used by the pass.

predefined_style.description: Predefined visual style for the pass.

colours.description: Explicit colour scheme for the pass.

ColourScheme.description: Explicit colours used to render a branded pass.

FieldId.description: Unique identifier for a custom field within a generic pass.

Image.description: An image used by pass branding.

asset_ref.description: Reference to an image asset managed by Revolut.

Issuer.description: Issuer information displayed on a pass.

issuer_id.description:
Revolut-managed identifier of the issuer. Revolut derives this value from the authenticated
partner and returns the partner's Revolut-assigned UUID; do not send it in request bodies.

issuer_full_name.description: Full legal name of the issuer.

Localisation.description:
Translations for a pass or template. The outer keys are lowercase ISO 639-1 language codes
(e.g. `en`); the inner keys are localisation keys mapped to the translated string. Keys are
resolved by the `localisation_key` on `LocalisedText` fields (field labels, action labels,
trigger presentation) at render time, in this order: the template's localisation map first,
then Revolut's localisation catalogue (Revolut-curated translations for standard pass
strings), then the field's `default` text.

propertyNames.description: Lowercase ISO 639-1 language code, such as `en` or `fr`.

additionalProperties.description: Translations for one language, keyed by localisation key.
The translated string for this localisation key.

default.description: Fallback text when no localisation matches.

localisation_key.description:
Key resolved at render time against the template's localisation map, then Revolut's
localisation catalogue (Revolut-curated translations for standard pass strings), falling
back to the `default` text.

PositionalPresentation.description:
Maps field IDs into header, primary, secondary, and footer sections. This layout may be supplied on the
pass or by its template. Every referenced ID must match a field in the pass, and every field ID
must appear at least once as a `field_id` or `join_field_id` when this layout is used.

header.description: Optional header section row, displayed before the primary section.

primary.description: Primary section row, displayed after the header when provided.

secondary.description: Optional secondary section rows, in display order.

Presentation.description: How a trigger is presented to the customer.

title.description: Title text for the notification or tile, with optional localisation.

description.description: Body text for the notification or tile, with optional localisation.

PresentationConfig.description:
Optional explicit positional layout for a generic pass. When omitted, the template presentation
is used. When neither provides a presentation, the pass is rendered from semantic metadata on
every field.

PresentationRow.description: A row in a positional generic-pass presentation.

RefreshPolicy.description: When passes created from a template refresh their content, and how often refreshes are allowed.

condition.description:
The event that triggers a content refresh:

| Value | Description |
| ----- | ----------- |
| `on_open` | The customer opens the pass. |
| `on_shown` | The pass is shown on the customer's screen. |
| `on_manual_refresh` | The customer explicitly refreshes the pass. |

cooldown_period.description:
Minimum interval between content refreshes, as an ISO 8601 duration (e.g. `PT5M` for
5 minutes, `PT1H` for 1 hour). Refresh events that arrive within the cooldown period are
skipped. `PT0S` disables the cooldown: every triggering event refreshes content.

RowItem.description: A field placed in a positional presentation row.

field_id.description: ID of the primary field displayed in this slot.

join_field_id.description: Optional ID of a field joined to the primary field in the same slot.

alignment.description: Horizontal placement of the slot within its row.

Trigger.description: A context-aware notification that nudges the customer (e.g. proximity alert, time before event).

id.description: Unique identifier for the trigger within this pass.

importance.description: Relative prominence of this trigger (5 = high, 1 = low).

time_offset.description: ISO 8601 duration before the target (e.g. `PT1H` for 1 hour before departure).

radius_meters.description: Radius in meters around the `location_targets` coordinates for the proximity alert.

field_target.description: Name of the semantic field to watch for changes (e.g. `boarding.gate`).

presentation.description: How the trigger is presented to the customer (notification, tile).
